remarks: Pristine elegance meets modern convenience in this sophisticated condo located in the highly sought-after Maritime Building in SoNo. This corner unit boasts an abundance of natural light, thanks to its floor-to-ceiling windows that frame stunning views of the surrounding area. The open layout is complemented by sleek bamboo floors and a contemporary kitchen outfitted with a new refrigerator and dishwasher. Both bathrooms are thoughtfully styled, offering a spa-like retreat. Step onto your private balcony to enjoy the fresh air, or take advantage of the building's luxury amenities, including a fitness center, common room, and secure garage parking. With a new HVAC system and water heater, this home is truly move-in ready. Perfectly situated just steps from SoNo's vibrant dining scene and the train station, this condo combines style, comfort, and unbeatable convenience.
